items.brief: Circle acquires Tazapay for $400M to bridge stablecoins with local banking
items.why: Regulated infrastructure connecting stablecoins to traditional banking systems strengthens tokenization ecosystem.

items.brief: Visa links VisaNet data with onchain lending for stablecoin issuer credit
items.why: Stablecoin settlement data used to enable blockchain-based credit products for tokenization participants.

items.brief: India's REC issues ₹5 billion tokenized corporate bond via distributed ledger
items.why: State-owned company tokenizes bond issuance under regulatory sandbox, advancing RWA tokenization.

items.brief: Visa stablecoin settlement volume reaches $20B annualized run rate, up 15x
items.why: Demonstrates significant payment use case growth validating stablecoin infrastructure maturation.

items.brief: Robinhood chain fees could reach $160M annually by 2028 via tokenized stocks
items.why: Tokenized equity trading adoption projected to drive substantial network economics.

items.brief: South Korea budget office warns stablecoins could save merchants $3.8B yearly
items.why: Analysis of stablecoin economic impact on payments and banking infrastructure relevant to adoption.

items.brief: Citi and DBS complete tokenized cross-border deposit transfer via Swift
items.why: Tokenized deposit settlement over blockchain demonstrates institutional RWA infrastructure progress.
